newsitem.title: USA: Dow closes lower after this week's rise to 7,000.
newsitem.headline: Dow closes lower after this week's rise to 7,000.

text.p: The Dow Jones industrial average closed lower Friday as Wall Street called time out one day after the blue-chip index closed above 7,000 points for the first time.

Based on early and unofficial data, the Dow was off 33.48 points at 6,988.96, retreating from Thursday's record close of 7,022.44. In the broader market, advancing issues led declines 13-11 on active volume of 483 million shares on the New York Stock Exchange.
